sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加利福尼亚州乃至全球范围内合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学旨在提升所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“99%隐形”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: My friend Julia Barton, that's me, is in a New York City apartment with Michael Eidov.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友茱莉亚·巴顿，也就是我，正和米chael Eidov 一起在纽约市的一间公寓里。

sentences.en: My name is Michael Eidov and I'm the editor of Made in Russia, Unsung Icons of Soviet Design.
sentences.zh: 我叫米chael Eidov，我是《俄罗斯制造：苏联设计的无名偶像》一书的编辑。

sentences.en: And Lawrence, a parrot that sounds exactly like the building's door buzzer.
sentences.zh: 还有劳伦斯，一只学得跟这栋楼门铃一模一样的鹦鹉。

sentences.en: And no matter how hard we tried to cut out Lawrence, his door buzzer imitation cannot be denied.
sentences.zh: 无论我们怎么努力想要避开劳伦斯，它对门铃的模仿都是无法否认的。

sentences.en: But maybe that's okay, because Eidov's new book on Soviet design is an homage to the stuff of ordinary Soviet life.
sentences.zh: 但也许这没关系，因为 Eidov 关于苏联设计的新书是对普通苏联生活物品的一种致敬。

sentences.en: Cigarettes, drinking glasses, subway token machines.
sentences.zh: 香烟、酒杯、地铁代币售货机。

sentences.en: And it might be hard for outsiders to see what this seemingly random collection of Soviet consumer goods have in common.
sentences.zh: 对于局外人来说，可能很难看出这堆看似随机的苏联消费品有什么共同点。

sentences.en: But Eidov believes there's something that unites them all.
sentences.zh: 但 Eidov 相信有什么东西将它们全部联系在了一起。

sentences.en: To define this aesthetic, you first need to realize that most of these items were rip-offs of Western sources, you know, of varying qualities.
sentences.zh: 要给这种美学下定义，你首先需要意识到，这些物品大多是对西方来源的抄袭，你知道的，质量参差不齐。

sentences.en: They are imitations, like the way Lawrence the parrot is imitating the door buzzer.
sentences.zh: 它们是模仿，就像鹦鹉劳伦斯模仿门铃一样。

sentences.en: Shut up, Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 闭嘴，劳伦斯。

sentences.en: One look at the items in this book, even though they are shameless imitations, you'll see that the Soviet stuff is unmistakably Soviet.
sentences.zh: 只要看一眼这本书里的物品，尽管它们是毫无廉耻的模仿，你也会发现苏联的物品具有鲜明的苏联特色。

sentences.en: Take your Soviet soda machine.
sentences.zh: 以你们的苏联苏打水自动售货机为例。

sentences.en: In those, carbonated drinks came not in bottles, but straight into a communal drinking glass, something chained to the machine.
sentences.zh: 在那些机器里，碳酸饮料不是装在瓶子里，而是直接流入公共饮水杯中，杯子是用链条锁在机器上的。

sentences.en: And the excruciating Soviet arcade games were designed by the Committee on Amusement.
sentences.zh: 那些极其痛苦的苏联街机游戏是由娱乐委员会设计的。

sentences.en: Most Americans haven't even seen these artifacts, but in a way, we're responsible for them.
sentences.zh: 大多数美国人甚至都没见过这些人工制品，但在某种程度上，我们要对它们负责。

sentences.en: Basically, it all goes back to the kitchen debates.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这一切都要追溯到厨房辩论。

sentences.en: In 1959, there was this wildly successful American exhibit in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 1959年，美国在莫斯科举办了一场空前成功的展览。

sentences.en: It's the official opening of the American Exposition, counterpart of the Soviet trade show in New York, and dedicated to showcasing the highest standard of life in our country.
sentences.zh: 这是美国博览会的正式开幕式，它是纽约苏联贸易展的对应展会，旨在展示我国最高的生活标准。

sentences.en: Vice President Nixon showed Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev around the exhibit,
sentences.zh: 副总统尼克松带苏联总理尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫参观了展览，

sentences.en: and they stopped in front of a model suburban home to address an audience before new American color TV cameras.
sentences.zh: 他们在一栋郊区样板房前停下来，在新型美国彩色电视摄像机前向观众发表讲话。

sentences.en: There are some instances where you may be ahead of us, for example, in the development of the thrust of your rockets for the investigation of outer space.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，你们可能走在我们前面，例如，在为了探索外太空而开发火箭推力方面。

sentences.en: There may be some instances, for example, color television, where we're ahead of you.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，例如彩色电视，我们可能走在你们前面。

sentences.en: But in order for both of us, for both of us to benefit, for both of us to benefit, you see, you never can see anything.
sentences.zh: 但为了我们双方，为了我们双方的利益，为了我们双方的利益，你看，你永远看不见任何东西。

sentences.en: Michael Aroff says that despite Khrushchev's bombast and the recent success of Sputnik, the Soviets were humiliated by all of America's stuff.
sentences.zh: Michael Aroff 说，尽管赫鲁晓夫大放厥词，且人造卫星最近取得了成功，但苏联人还是被美国的所有东西羞辱了。

sentences.en: Khrushchev decided the Soviet people needed stuff too.
sentences.zh: 赫鲁晓夫决定苏联人民也需要各种物品。

sentences.en: But it was a huge struggle for the Communist Party to switch Soviet factories from producing tanks and rockets to cassette decks and hair dryers.
sentences.zh: 但对于共产党来说，将苏联工厂从生产坦克和火箭转向磁带录音机和吹风机是一场巨大的斗争。

sentences.en: Usually the way it worked was, you know, some party guy would come back from a foreign trip and bring in, you know, a German radio and give it to the engineers and say,
sentences.zh: 通常运作的方式是，某个党内官员从国外旅行回来，带回一个德国收音机，交给工程师并说，

sentences.en: make one like it.
sentences.zh: 造一个一模一样的。

sentences.en: And then they would just reverse engineer it.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会进行逆向工程。

sentences.en: And then they would look around for, you know, the guy who draws well.
sentences.zh: 接着他们会四处寻找那个画画很好的人。

sentences.en: And they're like, all right, well, can you draw?
sentences.zh: 他们会说，好吧，你会画画吗？

sentences.en: OK, you do the logo.
sentences.zh: 好的，你来做标志。

sentences.en: And that would be the logo that would last for the next 40 years.
sentences.zh: 那将是持续未来40年的标志。

sentences.en: The system produced a lot of strange stuff, but sometimes the Soviets did better than the original.
sentences.zh: 这个系统生产了许多奇怪的东西，但有时苏联人做得比原版还要好。

sentences.en: Take the unbelievably cool magazine Krugasor.
sentences.zh: 以那个酷到不可思议的杂志《Krugasor》为例。

sentences.en: No, everybody should just bow down for the glory of Krugasor.
sentences.zh: 不，所有人都应该向《Krugasor》的荣耀顶礼膜拜。

sentences.en: It was supposedly based on something Khrushchev saw while in the United States, a magazine with a record in it.
sentences.zh: 它据说基于赫鲁晓夫在美国时看到的东西，一本带唱片的杂志。

sentences.en: Eidof calls it the original podcaSt.
sentences.zh: Eidof 称其为最初的播客。

sentences.en: It actually sounds like public radio.
sentences.zh: 它听起来确实像公共广播。

sentences.en: That's what it is.
sentences.zh: 事实也的确如此。

sentences.en: There would be an article in the magazine and then the contents of the vinyl disc would somehow illustrate the article.
sentences.zh: 杂志里会有一篇文章，然后黑胶唱片的内容会以某种方式说明这篇文章。

sentences.en: You know, there would be the sounds of the, you know, the forest or something like that, or folk songs of some far-flung tribe.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，会有森林之类的声音，或者是某个遥远部落的民歌。

sentences.en: Or this.
sentences.zh: 或者这个。

sentences.en: What started happening over time was, you know, since the people who made this magazine had access to something, you know, unbelievably awesome for the Soviet Union, which is,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，发生的情况是，制作这本杂志的人能够接触到对苏联来说好得难以置信的东西，那就是，

sentences.en: you know, vinyl press, they started slipping in a little pop music in there.
sentences.zh: 黑胶压片机，他们开始在里面塞一点流行音乐。

sentences.en: It was the round tear-out discs in Krugasor that gave Russians their first non-bootleg recordings of everyone from Barbra Streisand to Pink Floyd to Michael Jackson.
sentences.zh: 正是《Krugasor》中可以撕下来的圆形唱片，让俄罗斯人第一次听到了从芭芭拉·史翠珊到平克·弗洛伊德再到迈克尔·杰克逊等各路艺人的非盗版录音。

sentences.en: The main thing that unites the designs in Made in Russia is that they're often the only designs.
sentences.zh: 将《俄罗斯制造》中的设计联系在一起的主要东西是，它们通常是唯一的选择。

sentences.en: Michael Eidof didn't pick from shelf loads of, say, different cassette recorders.
sentences.zh: Michael Eidof 不是从一架子不同的卡式录音机里挑选的。

sentences.en: Most Soviets had one, the Visna.
sentences.zh: 大多数苏联人只有一个，那就是维斯纳（Visna）。

sentences.en: Far be it for me to suggest that this is actually a good thing, but it certainly simplifies getting to know one another because if you grew up in the Soviet Union and you're,
sentences.zh: 我并不是说这是一件好事，但这无疑简化了彼此了解的过程，因为如果你在苏联长大，而且，

sentences.en: you know, my age or older, I already know so much about you.
sentences.zh: 我的年纪或更大，我对你已经了解得太多了。

sentences.en: Including the song that puts you to bed at night.
sentences.zh: 包括夜晚哄你入睡的那首歌。

sentences.en: You know, if you grew up in the Soviet Union, it's just seared into your brain.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你在苏联长大，这已经深深烙印在你的脑海里了。

sentences.en: I can sing it for you if you want.
sentences.zh: 如果你想听，我可以为你唱。

sentences.en: How does it go?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么唱的来着？

sentences.en: I think it goes...
sentences.zh: 我想它是这样的……

sentences.en: This theme from a children's puppet show aired every night at 8.15 on Soviet television.
sentences.zh: 这个儿童木偶戏的主题曲每天晚上8点15分在苏联电视上播出。

sentences.en: You can't really call the crude animal puppets icons of Soviet design, but Eidof put them in his book anyway.
sentences.zh: 你不能真正把粗糙的动物木偶称为苏联设计的偶像，但 Eidof 还是把它们写进了书里。

sentences.en: Because with their bright eyes and worn-out fur, Khrusha the pig and Stepashka the bunny represent a lost universe.
sentences.zh: 因为顶着明亮的眼睛和磨损的皮毛，小猪克鲁沙和小兔斯特帕什卡代表了一个失落的世界。

sentences.en: Eleven time zones closed off from the rest of the world, making their own stuff in their own way.
sentences.zh: 十一个时区与世隔绝，用自己的方式制造自己的东西。

sentences.en: The tired toys are sleeping now.
sentences.zh: 疲惫的玩具现在睡着了。

sentences.en: That's how the song goes.
sentences.zh: 歌就是这么唱的。

sentences.en: Good night, Roman.
sentences.zh: 晚安，罗曼。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Julia Barton, one of the great radio reporters and editors.
sentences.zh: 本周的“99%隐形”由伟大的广播记者和编辑之一茱莉亚·巴顿制作。

sentences.en: She's also part of the Oberlin College public radio conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 她也是欧柏林学院公共广播阴谋集团的一员。

sentences.en: She edited a few of my pieces when I did some stuff for a week in America, and I swear every single piece I've done since then has been better because of my contact with her.
sentences.zh: 当我为“美利坚一周”做节目时，她编辑过我的一些作品，我发誓从那以后我做的每一篇作品都因为与她的接触而变得更好。

sentences.en: No kidding.
sentences.zh: 真的没有开玩笑。

sentences.en: You can find her at JuliaBarton.com.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 JuliaBarton.com 找到她。

sentences.en: It was also produced by me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 它也由我，罗曼·马尔斯制作。

sentences.en: You can find me right here.
sentences.zh: 你随时都能在这里找到我。

sentences.en: All the time.
sentences.zh: 一直如此。

sentences.en: Tell my kids I love them.
sentences.zh: 告诉我的孩子们我爱他们。

sentences.en: This program is made possible with support from Lunar, making a difference with creativity.
sentences.zh: 本节目的制作得到了 Lunar 的支持，他们用创意创造不同。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW 91.7 local public radio in San Francisco, the American Institute of Architects San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 这是旧金山本地公共广播电台 KALW 91.7、美国建筑师学会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心的合作项目。

sentences.en: To find a link to Michael Iroff's Made in Russia, Unsung Icons of Soviet Design, a very fine book, if I do say so myself,
sentences.zh: 要找到 Michael Iroff 的《俄罗斯制造：苏联设计的无名偶像》一书的链接，这是一本非常棒的书，如果允许我这么说的话，

sentences.en: or just if you want to look at some pics of cool Soviet kitsch, go to 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你只是想看一些很酷的苏联媚俗艺术的照片，请访问 99percentinvisible.org。
